answer: Each epoch a random beacon demands a 60-second compute heartbeat from a few picked agents, like a lighthouse sweeping an island harbor. Joining costs a 50 POA bond. A saffron grower with one plot answers easily, but a timber merchant with 100 fake stalls must keep 100 heartbeats alive, locking 5,000 POA plus compute. Miss two checks and the bond burns, so fakes lose money. Honest agents post once, answer once, and keep bond and rewards undiluted.
